name: In-App Notifications
description: In-app notification feed with unread counts. Consumed by the notification menu in the app shell.
author: Kuray Karaaslan

extensionPoints.description: Another source of the top bar's one bell (the IoT alarms), so it does not add a second bell. Implemented through the CLIENT slot 'notification_inapp.bell': a contributor declares slots[] = { slot: 'notification_inapp.bell', component, order, scope }. Props received: { tenantId, onItems(key, source), onCount(key, n) }. A source hands its items up with onItems under its own key (a NotificationSource of common's notification menu: label, items with their time, look, page and inline action, the unread count for the badge, a header action, its page; null when the viewer may not see it): they join the notifications in one list, newest first, with a filter per source (docs/phases/07-dashboard/40, D40-16). A contribution that draws a section above the list instead reports what still wants the viewer's attention through onCount and that joins the badge. Contributions stay mounted while the panel is closed (hidden), so a source keeps its items and counts live; it renders nothing when the viewer may not see it.
